description: This file defines the implementation of the Equation class within the GraphControl namespace, including methods for generating graph requests, handling expression data, and managing visual properties like line color. classes.name: Equation
classes.description: Represents a mathematical equation with methods to generate graph requests, manage visual properties, and determine graphability.

methods.name: GetRequest

methods.name: GetExpression
